description: Gemini 1.5 Flash is Google's fast and cost-efficient multimodal model, distilled from Gemini 1.5 Pro. It offers a 1 million token context window with significantly lower latency and cost, making it ideal for high-volume applications.

outOfScope: Tasks requiring maximum accuracy over speed

trainingData.description: Distilled from Gemini 1.5 Pro using knowledge distillation techniques. Trained on diverse multimodal data.

trainingProcedure: Knowledge distillation from Gemini 1.5 Pro, optimized for speed and efficiency.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Optimized for speed with strong performance. Lower latency than Pro while maintaining good accuracy for most tasks.

knownLimitations: Less capable than Gemini 1.5 Pro on complex reasoning tasks
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Cannot access real-time information or browse the internet
Trade-off between speed and accuracy compared to Pro

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Google applies safety training and evaluation to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in safety filters and content moderation.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data handling governed by Google Cloud terms.

access.license: Proprietary - Google Cloud Terms of Service

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Google), also available via Vertex AI
